Context: 6. Medical Advance

## 6. Medical Advance  
Admissibility.1. Admissible to all Government servants inrespective of pay limit.  
2. An advance may be paid for in-patient treatment in a recognized hospital.
3. May also be paid for treatment ofTB, Cancer, Acute Myetoid' Leukemia & 'D' at the consulting room of the Medical Officer, at the residence of the Government servant or as, an out
3. and Chronic Active Hepatitis 'B', 'C' patient.
4. For purchase/ replacement, repair and adjustment of admissible artificial appliances.
